name: gradient-magic-ray

frames.best_why: Frame 1 holds the full panel and shows the pink, purple and blue bands most evenly.

tagline: Hot pink sweeps into deep violet and then into blue.
summary: A static multi-stop gradient laid on a shallow diagonal: strong hot pink on the left, a dark purple waist, and blue on the right, all inside a wide rounded panel.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle on a black stage. Hot pink occupies the left side, deepening into a moody violet across the middle before easing into medium blue at the right edge, with a faint diagonal grain in the blend.
behaviour: Static: nothing changes; the same pink-to-blue sweep repeats in each frame.
search_phrases: gradient backdrop for a night event
use_when: A rich pink-purple-blue field should add drama behind a title or feature panel.
avoid_when: The saturated stops are fixed in the source and clash with a light or neutral palette.
customise: className and style resize it or replace the paint; the pink, purple and blue stops and the angle are in the source.
weight_why: One div painted with a CSS gradient; no scripts or animation.

a11y.note: Decorative gradient only, so there are no controls or labels to provide.

issues: Frames show a rounded inset panel, which contradicts the packet's full-bleed footprint.
polish_why: The blend is smooth and even; a pleasant but unremarkable static gradient.
